overview_description.description: Coral is a climate technology and software company that provides an AI-native ESG platform designed for enterprise sustainability management, emissions accounting, and regulatory reporting. Its software supports data collection, validation, emissions calculation, analytics, compliance reporting, reduction planning, and carbon offset tracking. Coral’s platform covers Scope 1, Scope 2, and Scope 3 emissions management and includes workflows for environmental, social, and governance (ESG) reporting aligned with standards such as GHG Protocol, CSRD/ESRS, GRI, ISO 14064-1, and CBAM. The company also provides audit trails, reporting controls, API integrations, and cloud-based infrastructure hosted on Microsoft Azure.
